description: Lattice-extracted vacuum column of the doubled-Fibonacci modular S-matrix, used as a genuinely independent second route for the Korbany mutual-information witness H (Sec. 'Three certificates', item 1). The values |S_{0a}|^2 are the normalized topological-sector weights read off the extracted S; their Shannon entropy reproduces the analytic H=1.700979 to the lattice-extraction residual.

provenance.quantity: Full signed modular S and T of doubled Fibonacci, extracted from a 3x3 lattice via the C3 (rotation) channel (Li-Mong 2203.04329 V.1)
provenance.extractor: extract_c3.extract (vacuum-row-positivity constraint S_{v,a}=d_a S_{v,v}>0; extract() receives only measured Wilson-loop and C3-rotation matrices; no F/R symbols, no analytic S/T, no doubled-Fibonacci quantum dimensions enter the extraction)
provenance.lattice_input_location: Both lattice inputs are deposited in the companion record (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21362245) as p6_V_gs_3x3.npy and p6_Mgs_j_3x3.npy; the md5 values above identify them there. They are not duplicated in this record.
provenance.note: Vacuum column identified intrinsically as the unique all-positive column of the extracted S (S_{0a}=d_a/D>0), without theory labeling. The lattice extraction is an independent data source from the analytic quantum dimensions d=(1,phi,phi,phi^2).
